Name: Compact farm
Author: rkpiotr
Description:
Adds a new farm to the list - a compact but fully functional farm map.

Forest foraging enabled. Balance between small and allowing for some buildings, farming.

You can select one of few starter packs:

[list]
[*][b]Parsnips [/b](default): 15 parsnip seeds and some parsnip soup.

[*][b]Farming[/b]: Golden watering can and hoe, 20 speed grow, 20 coffee beans, 3 kegs, 3 large chests

[*][b]Foraging: [/b]Golden Axe and pickaxe, wooden sword, 3x furnace, 2x recycle machine, 20 field snacks, 3 large chests

[*][b]Fishing[/b]: Fish smoker, Bait maker, 3 large chests, 5 worm bins, 10 crap pots, 2 midnight carp, 2 squid
[*][b]Wild Farming[/b]: 40 of each seasonal seeds, Golden watering can and hoe, 3 large chests
[*][b]Tooling[/b]: Golden tools, wooden sword, 3x large chest
[/list]To change edit config.json file or use GenericModConfigMenu mod to configure it in-game before starting a new game.
